SELECT t_system_user.id, t_system_user.user_name AS userName, t_system_user.real_name AS realName, t_system_user.user_photo AS userPhoto, t_system_user.email, t_system_user.mobile, t_system_user.`status`, CASE t_system_user.`status` WHEN 0 THEN '正常' WHEN 1 THEN '禁用' WHEN 2 THEN '已锁定' ELSE '' END AS statusName, t_system_user.gmt_create AS gmtCreate, t_system_user.gmt_modified AS gmtModified, ( SELECT GROUP_CONCAT(t_system_role.role_name) FROM t_system_user_role LEFT JOIN t_system_role ON t_system_user_role.role_id = t_system_role.id WHERE t_system_user_role.user_id = t_system_user.id ) AS roleName FROM t_system_user WHERE t_system_user.is_deleted = #{param.deleted} AND t_system_user.user_name != #{param.neUserName}
AND t_system_user.user_name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{param.userName}, '%')
AND t_system_user.real_name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{param.realName}, '%')
AND t_system_user.mobile LIKE CONCAT('%', #{param.mobile}, '%')
AND t_system_user.status = #{param.status}
AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM t_system_user_role WHERE t_system_user_role.user_id = t_system_user.id AND t_system_user_role.role_id = #{param.roleId} )
AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM t_system_user_org WHERE t_system_user_org.user_id = t_system_user.id AND t_system_user_org.org_id = #{param.orgId} )
ORDER BY t_system_user.gmt_modified DESC
